text: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) combines document retrieval with LLM generation. It retrieves relevant documents and uses them as context for generating accurate, grounded responses.
RAG improves LLM accuracy by providing factual context. This reduces hallucination and ensures responses are grounded in real data from your knowledge base.
Embeddings convert text to dense vectors. Models like sentence-transformers create semantic representations that enable similarity search. FAISS provides efficient nearest-neighbor search.
Agentic systems use planning, tool use, and reasoning. An agent planner decides which tools to use, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes results into coherent responses.
